description: This PHP source file provides utility functions for array manipulation, including conversion, diff operations, merging, and string generation, as well as a class for dot-notation access in nested arrays. It is used internally within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM project for array handling tasks.

classes.name: SugarArray
classes.description: A wrapper around PHP's ArrayObject providing dot-notation recursive searching for multi-dimensional arrays.

methods.name: var_export_helper
methods.description: Helper that exports an array to a string representation using var_export.

methods.name: override_value_to_string
methods.description: Generates PHP code string to override a value in an array.

methods.name: add_blank_option
methods.description: Ensures that an options array has a blank option at the start.

methods.name: override_value_to_string_recursive
methods.description: Recursively generates PHP code strings to override nested array values.

methods.name: override_recursive_helper
methods.description: Helper for recursive override string generation for nested arrays.

methods.name: override_value_to_string_recursive2
methods.description: Alternative recursive function to generate override PHP code strings.

methods.name: object_to_array_recursive
methods.description: Converts an object, including nested objects, to an array.

methods.name: deepArrayDiff
methods.description: Computes the differences between two arrays, considering nested arrays.

methods.name: setDeepArrayValue
methods.description: Sets a value in a multi-dimensional array, creating sub-arrays as needed, supporting underscores as path separators.

methods.name: array_merge_values
methods.description: Merges two arrays by concatenating string values at corresponding positions; returns false if array sizes differ.

methods.name: array_search_insensitive
methods.description: Searches for a value in an array ignoring case sensitivity.

methods.name: fixIndexArrayFormat
methods.description: Formats index definitions to standardize whitespace and parentheses spacing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the array using dot notation, with a default fallback.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Static method to get a value from a given array using dot notation.

methods.name: _getFromSource
methods.description: Internal method to extract a value from the array source.

methods.name: _getRecursive
methods.description: Recursive helper for nested value retrieval via dot notation.
